title: Boot Banner
story:
The station's firmware won't start the next boot stage until it sees its banner, character for character.

Print exactly these three lines (no input):

`KERNEL-7 BOOT`
`life support: OFFLINE`
`engineer: ONLINE`

tests.expected:
KERNEL-7 BOOT
life support: OFFLINE
engineer: ONLINE

hints: Each line is its own printf, the same shape as the first one.
`\n` at the end of the text inside the quotes moves to the next line.
Check capitals and the space after each colon: the firmware is picky.
